column1: # Forbidden adjacencies (school-grammar morphotactics): a token of class `left` is never followed by one of
# class `right`. Compiled into model/conn.tsv by build/mkrules.py; a path with a forbidden pair is taken only
# Selectors: atoms joined by &, alternatives of such separated by " / "; key=a|b (any of); ! negates. Keys: ud (prefix of pos1-pos4), ctype (prefix),
# cform (prefix), lemma (exact; function words and 非自立可能 words carry their lemma), bos (line start or end).

column5: note

column3: ud=動詞|形容詞|助動詞|接尾辞 & cform=未然形
column4: !lemma=ない|ず|れる|られる|せる|させる|しめる|まい|へん|む|はる|や|じ
column5: the irrealis form only before the auxiliaries that take it (書か+ない, 書か+れる, せ+ず)

column3: cform=連用形-イ音便|連用形-促音便|連用形-撥音便 & !lemma=@hon-ra
column4: !lemma=て|た|たり|たって|てる|ちゃう|ちまう|とく|てく|とる|てらっしゃる|ます
column5: a sound-changed continuative only before t/d endings (書い+て, 待っ+た, 読ん+で); ござい/いらっしゃい+ます

column3: ud=動詞|形容詞|助動詞|接尾辞 & cform=仮定形-一般 & !lemma=た|だ|なんだ
column5: the conditional form only before ば (書け+ば, なけれ+ば); たら and なら stand alone
ます only after a continuative (書き+ます)
た/だ only after a continuative (書い+た, 高かっ+た, でし+た)
て/で only after a continuative, or ない (書い+て, 読ん+で, 来+ない+で)
the auxiliary ない only after an irrealis form (書か+ない); 無い after く is the adjective

column4: ud=助動詞 & lemma=れる|られる|せる|させる|しめる
column5: voice auxiliaries only after an irrealis form (書か+れる, 食べ+させる, さ+せる)
たい only after a continuative (書き+たい)
ば only after a conditional form (書け+ば); ってば
を never right after a predicate; ざる+を (得ない) is the exception

column3: ud=助詞|助動詞|動詞|形容詞|形状詞|連体詞|接頭辞|副詞
column5: a conjunction opens a sentence or clause, or joins nouns (東京及び大阪); never right after a particle or a predicate

column4: bos / ud=助詞|助動詞|補助記号|接尾辞|接続詞|感動詞
column5: a prefix needs a content word after it (お+礼, 御+願い)

column3: bos / ud=助詞|助動詞|補助記号|接続詞|感動詞|接頭辞
column5: a suffix needs a word before it (東雲+さん, 学園+長)

column4: ud=助動詞|助詞-格助詞|助詞-係助詞|助詞-接続助詞|助詞-準体助詞 & !lemma=と|つう|って|や
column5: an imperative ends its clause: no auxiliary or case, topic, conjunctive particle after it except the quoting と (来いと言った)

column4: ud=助動詞|助詞-格助詞|助詞-係助詞|助詞-接続助詞|助詞-準体助詞 & !lemma=と|って|つう
column5: a sentence-final particle ends its clause: only another final particle, a quoting と/って or punctuation follow

column3: ud=助詞-格助詞|助詞-係助詞|助詞-準体助詞|助詞-接続助詞|接頭辞 / cform=未然形|連用形-イ音便|連用形-促音便|連用形-撥音便|仮定形|語幹
column4: ud=感動詞 & !lemma=有り難う|御免|今日は|今晩は|御早う|宜しく
column5: an interjection opens an utterance: it never follows a case, topic or conjunctive particle, a prefix or a non-final form directly

column4: ud=名詞|代名詞|助詞-準体助詞|形状詞-助動詞語幹 & !lemma=みたい
column5: the conclusive form ends a clause: a noun, the nominalizer の or よう after a predicate takes its attributive form (行く人 is 連体形); みたい follows the conclusive form

column4: ud=補助記号-句点|助詞-終助詞|助詞-接続助詞 & !lemma=の
column5: the attributive form modifies what follows: never before a full stop, a final or conjunctive particle, which take the conclusive form; the final の takes the attributive form (何なの)

column3: !ud=形状詞|名詞-普通名詞-形状詞可能|名詞-普通名詞-サ変形状詞可能|接尾辞-形状詞的
column5: the copula's adverbial に only after a na-adjective stem (静か+に, 好意的+に); after a noun に is the case particle

column4: !bos & !ud=補助記号 & !lemma=有る|無い|御座る|居る|は|も|ない|すら|さえ|こそ|しか
column5: the copula's continuative で before ある/ない/ござる/いる, a topic or focus particle, or a pause (学生で、 学生ではない); elsewhere で is the case particle
the dialect conjunctive particle すけ follows a predicate, never a noun (佳奈すけ is a nickname)

column4: ud=助詞-副助詞|助動詞 & lemma=って|つう
column5: the quoting って never follows a continuative: 言っ+て, not 言+って
ず/ぬ/ん (negation) only after an irrealis form (書か+ず, ませ+ん)

column4: ud=助動詞 & lemma=てる|ちゃう|ちまう|とく|てく|とる|たる|たげる|てらっしゃる
column5: contracted auxiliaries (てる = ている, ちゃう = てしまう …) take the continuative like the て they contain (見+てる, 言っ+ちゃう)
after a predicate の is the nominalizer or the final particle, not the genitive case particle

column3: ud=動詞|形容詞 & cform=終止形
column4: ud=動詞|形容詞|連体詞|接頭辞|接尾辞|形状詞-一般
column5: a verb or adjective right before a content word is attributive (大きい木, 走る人), not conclusive
the clipped attributive て of てる only before the nominalizer の/ん (ふらつい+て+ん+だ)
an adjective stem stands before そう, すぎる, さ, げ or the end, never before a particle (よ+ね is the final particle, not 良い)
a conjunction opens a clause: never an auxiliary or ない right after it (彼しか+し+ない, not しかし+ない)

column3: ud=形容詞 & cform=終止形|連体形
column5: an adjective takes no case particle が/を directly; before them the word is a noun (臭いが: the smell) or が is conjunctive
only the honorific ラ行 verbs put ます after their イ音便 form (おっしゃい+ます; 仰い+ます is not 仰ぐ)
only the honorific お/ご prefixes a verb (お+願い); other prefixes take nouns (本+読み is 本 + 読む)
